defects.trigger: cursor(), execute(), or commit() raises after connect() has returned
defects.observed_result: startup continues because the exception is caught and None is returned; close_calls stays 0; rollbacks stays 0; _pg_conn is cleared
defects.application_cleanup: reference dropped without close or rollback
defects.harness_cleanup: closed the abandoned connection after the snapshot
defects.proposed_remediation: In the exception handler, roll back if a transaction is open, close the cursor, close the connection, and only then set both globals to None.

defects.severity: fatal startup leaves the connection open
defects.trigger: build_api or alert raises after get_connection succeeded
defects.observed_result: the exception escapes, yield is false, no tasks exist, and _pg_conn remains held with close_calls 0
defects.application_cleanup: finally is not entered and would not close the connection anyway
defects.harness_cleanup: closed the connection after the snapshot
defects.proposed_remediation: If startup aborts after get_connection, close that connection before the exception leaves lifespan. Do not close it on the success path if the process-global owner is intentional.

defects.trigger: create_task fails after the first task, or start_telegram_control raises after all four tasks
defects.observed_result: 1, 3, or 4 tasks remained pending; application cancelled none
defects.resource: inert scheduled tasks standing in for reconciliation, health, telegram, and run_bot
defects.application_cleanup: finally did not run because try starts at yield
defects.harness_cleanup: cancelled the pending tasks after the snapshot
defects.proposed_remediation: Start the try before the first create_task so finally cancels every task that was actually created.

defects.severity: shutdown stops at the first error
defects.observed_result: yield had happened and all 4 tasks stayed pending
defects.proposed_remediation: Catch the stop error, log it, and still cancel and await every task.

defects.severity: one task await skips the rest
defects.trigger: await of the health task raises something other than CancelledError
defects.proposed_remediation: Await each cancelled task inside its own try, and continue with the remaining tasks if one await fails.

ownership_exceptions.observation: After a successful startup and a normal task shutdown, the fake connection is still held and close_calls is 0.
ownership_exceptions.interpretation: The database module keeps one process-global connection. lifespan never closes it on the success path. This is ownership, not the same defect as dropping the reference without close.
